teaser.en: A dry-country shrub that covers its bare twigs in pinkish-white flowers before its leaves appear.
teaser.sw: Kichaka cha nchi kavu kinachofunika vijiti vyake vitupu kwa maua meupe-waridi kabla majani yake hayajachipuka.

summary.en: Mfyofyo is a deciduous shrub of the coffee family that flowers on bare branches, its flowers sitting tight against the twigs. Pakia gives the same name to Heinsia crinita and Bourreria nemoralis.
summary.sw: Mfyofyo ni kichaka kinachopukutisha majani cha familia ya mibuni (kahawa), kinachochanua kwenye matawi matupu, maua yake yakiwa yamekaa kubana kwenye vijiti. Pakia anatoa jina hilo hilo kwa *Heinsia crinita* na *Bourreria nemoralis*.

about.en: Mfyofyo is a deciduous shrub or small tree with stiff, often short side shoots. Its leaves are small, opposite and elliptic, often clustered on the short shoots. The flowers come at the end of the dry season, often before the new leaves. They are white to pink, star-shaped and fragrant, and they sit almost without stalks on the twigs. *Apodanthera* means 'stalkless flower'. The small round fruits darken when ripe.
about.sw: Mfyofyo ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani, wenye machipukizi ya pembeni magumu na mara nyingi mafupi. Majani yake ni madogo, hukaa kwa jozi zinazotazamana na yana umbo la duaradufu, mara nyingi yakiwa yamejikusanya kwenye machipukizi mafupi. Maua hutokea mwishoni mwa kiangazi, mara nyingi kabla ya majani mapya. Ni meupe hadi waridi, yenye umbo la nyota na harufu nzuri, na hukaa karibu bila vikonyo juu ya vijiti. *Apodanthera* maana yake ni 'ua lisilo na kikonyo'. Matunda madogo ya mviringo hubadilika rangi yakawa meusi zaidi yanapoiva.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, thicket and wooded grassland, across tropical Africa.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika kavu ya vichaka, vichaka na nyasi zenye miti, kote katika Afrika ya tropiki.

uses.en: Pakia records no use. In West Africa the plant is used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote. Afrika Magharibi mmea huu hutumika katika tiba za jadi.

names.en: Digo: *mfyofyo*, shared with Duruma according to Pakia, who gives no meaning. The name is used for three unrelated shrubs in Pakia's lists: this species, *Heinsia crinita*, and *Bourreria nemoralis* (otherwise *mbunduchi*). No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mfyofyo*, linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma kwa mujibu wa Pakia, ambaye hatoi maana yake. Jina hili linatumika kwa vichaka vitatu visivyo na uhusiano katika orodha za Pakia: spishi hii, *Heinsia crinita*, na *Bourreria nemoralis* (kwa jina jingine *mbunduchi*). Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.

reason.sw: Mkimwemwe (bushveld gardenia), kichaka cha familia hiyo hiyo
